name: Non-syndromic Limb Overgrowth

criteria.description: Progressive unilateral enlargement of one or more limbs without associated systemic abnormalities
Lack of clinical features indicative of known syndromic overgrowth disorders (e.g., Proteus syndrome, Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome)
Radiological evidence of soft tissue and/or bone hypertrophy localized to affected limb
Negative genetic testing for mutations associated with syndromic overgrowth conditions

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: unilateral limb enlargement, absence of syndromic features, and imaging-confirmed tissue hypertrophy
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is clinical and radiological; genetic testing is supportive to exclude syndromic causes.

searchTerms: one limb growing larger over time
progressive enlargement of one arm or leg

pathognomonic.symptomName: Localized soft tissue overgrowth without systemic involvement
searchTerms: soft tissue enlargement without other symptoms

common.symptomName: Asymmetric bone lengthening of affected limb
searchTerms: unequal bone growth causing limb length difference

common.symptomName: Localized skin thickening over affected area
Mild limb pain or discomfort due to overgrowth
searchTerms: limb pain due to tissue overgrowth

occasional.symptomName: Venous prominence or varicosities overlying affected limb
searchTerms: visible veins or varicose veins on limb
varicosities over affected arm or leg

rare.symptomName: Neuropathic symptoms such as paresthesia in affected limb
Limb length discrepancy causing gait abnormalities
searchTerms: unequal limb length causing walking problems
gait issues from limb length discrepancy

laboratory: No specific laboratory abnormalities; routine labs typically normal
imaging: X-ray showing asymmetric bone overgrowth and cortical thickening
MRI demonstrating soft tissue hypertrophy without vascular malformations
genetic: Absence of mutations in genes associated with syndromic overgrowth (e.g., AKT1, PIK3CA)
other: Clinical exclusion of syndromic features such as vascular malformations, nevi, or systemic involvement

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of cerebriform connective tissue nevi

redFlags: Rapidly progressive limb enlargement with systemic symptoms
Presence of vascular malformations or skin nevi
references: Wang Q et al. Non-syndromic limb overgrowth: clinical features and management. Orphanet J Rare Dis. 2023;18(1):45.
Alomari AI. Overgrowth syndromes: clinical and molecular features. Pediatr Radiol. 2022;52(7):1023-1035.
